title: LLM Embedding-based Attribution (LEA): Quantifying Source Contributions to Generative Model's Response for Vulnerability Analysis
authors: Reza Fayyazi; Michael Zuzak; Shanchieh Jay Yang
why_relevant: Proposes an attribution metric (LEA) that quantifies whether LLM outputs rely on retrieved context vs internal parametric knowledge, and evaluates behavior under valid, generic, and incorrect retrieval—directly relevant to knowledge conflict and auditing RAG reliability.
why_not_or_caveat: Domain-specific to CVE/vulnerability analysis; method is more about attribution/auditing than improving robustness itself.
